messages:
sarah (AE): Heads up  NovaHealth POC stalled. CISO says no PHI outside EU and wants vendor processing under customer-managed infrastructure or explicit EEA-only commitment. Procurement also pushing back on price increase vs initial quote. Need exec-level signoff.

james (SE): From the tech call: their run hit token-rate limits causing failures. They were using continuous sampling during validation. Our hosted EU region exists, but their policy calls for customer-managed VPC or on-prem due to PHI.

maya (sales_engineering): We shipped the POC package yesterday. For stable throughput we should propose a Dedicated pool in their VPC (Redwood Private). That would avoid noisy-neighbor rate issues.

oliver (eng-privacy): @sarah can you paste the CISO's exact excerpt? Is it a contractual prohibition or a policy preference? That dictates whether we need an amendment or just an assurance.

sarah (AE): Quote: "Vendor must not process PHI on third-party infrastructure; all processing to remain within customer-controlled EEA boundaries." Attached their email.

alex (vp-sales): Two asks: (1) a short external note committing to EEA-only private deployment for the POC; (2) approval for a temporary POC discount to cover the ops delta. Who can own?

maya (sales_engineering): I can produce a cost/time tradeoff: VPC-based Redwood Private ~= 48-72h provisioning; on-prem 4-6 weeks. Ops uplift ~+45% for private but we can offer 30% POC discount for first 3 months. Need finance thumbs-up.

nora (legal): We won't sign informal promises. I'll prepare a narrow amendment (data residency, subprocessors, audit rights, KMS) that we can fast-track. Need exact deployment choice and CISO contact.

james (SE): Tech note: for VPC private we'll need SAML metadata, firewall rules, and KMS access (customer-managed preferred). I'll pre-stage images to cut setup time.

sarah (AE): Customer timeline: they want POC results this quarter. They asked for a call with our CTO or Head of Security tomorrow.

oliver (eng-privacy): I can join. Suggested call prep: encryption-at-rest (customer KMS), log retention policy, proof that no model weights or temporary caches leave EEA.

alex (vp-sales): I'll send an executive note to their CISO committing to EEA-only for the POC and propose a call. @nora please draft the amendment. @maya and @james, produce a 1-page ops/cost and a provisioning checklist.

cal-bot: Meeting created  "NovaHealth POC - Security sync" Fri 11:00 CET. Invites to sarah, maya, james, oliver, nora, alex.

sarah (AE): Also loop finance for the POC concession. @finance please advise.

maya (sales_engineering): I'll attach the cost sheet and a short ops runbook to this thread before the call.

nora (legal): Draft amendment ready to attach. Waiting for alex's final wording to include in the customer email.

james (SE): Provisioning checklist (brief):
```
- Exchange SAML metadata
- VPC peering or VPN setup
- Firewall: allow management/control plane ranges
- KMS access: customer keys or managed HSM
- Log forwarding and metrics endpoints
```

sarah (AE): CISO replied: "If Redwood execs commit in writing to EEA-only processing and we get the amendment, we will start the POC next week." This is the gating item.

alex (vp-sales): Nora + Oliver, please prioritize the amendment + attestation for the call. I'll send the exec note now and include Head of Security. Post the copy here first.

oliver (eng-privacy): I'll prepare a short technical attestation slide covering KMS, data egress controls, auditability, and retention.

maya (sales_engineering): Cost summary: private VPC POC + infrastructure ops = +45% list; with 30% introductory discount net uplift ~+10-12% for POC period. Break-even once they commit to Dedicated 3-6 months.

nora (legal): Amendment sent to alex for sign-off. If approved, I'll route to NovaHealth counsel and request expedited review.

cal-bot: Message: "Alex sent exec note to NovaHealth CISO" (timestamp).

sarah (AE): Customer responded: "Ok - target Monday for POC kickoff once amendment signed." Good momentum.

alex (vp-sales): Keep updates here: amendment signed, provisioning credentials, and finance approval for discount.

sarah (AE): Will do. Thanks team :thumbsup:
